sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Implement Spring Boot service with @RestController annotation for all course operations. Validate teacher schedule conflicts using database-level constraints and service-layer validation. Implement proper input validation for course title, dates, and teacher assignments. Use prepared statements for all database operations to prevent SQL injection.

Coder Agent: Implement courses table with all specified columns: course_id (UUID PK), title (VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL), description (TEXT), start_date (DATE NOT NULL), end_date (DATE NOT NULL), teacher_id (UUID NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY Users.user_id), max_students (INT DEFAULT 30). Add constraint to ensure end_date >= start_date. Create indexes for performance optimization on teacher_id and date ranges.

Coder Agent: Implement teacher assignment/unassignment endpoints with proper validation. Queue notifications for teacher mobile apps when assignments are made. Validate that teacher exists and is assigned the Teacher role before assignment. Implement idempotent assignment operations to prevent duplicate notifications.

Coder Agent: Implement database trigger to prevent overlapping course assignments for the same teacher. Validate that no teacher is assigned to multiple courses with intersecting date ranges. Raise appropriate error when conflict is detected.

Tester Agent: Achieve minimum 85% code coverage for all course management operations. Test conflict detection logic for teacher schedule overlaps. Validate notification queuing for teacher assignments. Test input validation and error handling for all endpoints.

Reviewer Agent: Validate OWASP compliance for all input handling and database operations. Check for proper exception handling and error reporting. Verify RBAC enforcement for course management operations. Ensure proper logging and audit trail implementation.
